verdict.rationale: Lium documents a public REST API: an API reference page publishing an OpenAPI spec at lium.io/api/openapi.json, concrete endpoints (POST /executors/rent-by-spec, POST /auth/signup), scoped API keys with server-enforced budgets, and stable error codes with hints. It also states an agent can do everything with no browser, and adds keyless JSON, CSV and WebSocket feeds. The probe's 404s were on docs.lium.io paths, not the documented lium.io/api/openapi.json, so they do not contradict the spec's existence. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on confirmation that the documented OpenAPI spec and endpoints work as described.
